evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build the reliable cloud foundations that help Jetstar think smarter and move faster.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD explicitly frames reliability and speed as a joint goal ('reliable cloud foundations... move faster'), and the role also names data quality/governance responsibilities, giving mixed weight to both.
evidence.domain_risk: ensure data quality and consistency... maintain robust data pipelines
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect commercial/strategic decision-making at a major airline without financial-reporting or regulatory-audit-specific language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Central Data Engineering; Commercial teams; BI; Product
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes an existing gold-layer data architecture, established BI/analytics tools, and coordination with a 'Central Data Engineering' function already in place across a complex aviation ecosystem, indicating a mature, specialized organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and build gold-layer data assets and semantic features that power self-service business reporting.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technical scope (gold-layer data assets, semantic features, Snowflake, Fivetran/dbt, agentic AI workflows) that shows exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: deliver insights that shape product, growth, and strategy decisions... Collaborate with BI, Data Engineering, and Product to maintain robust pipelines and models.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role explicitly serves Commercial teams and shapes 'product, growth, and commercial strategy decisions', a commercial orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Identify and communicate strategic opportunities where data can unlock business value.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic opportunity identification and mentoring junior analysts (strategic-leaning) with maintaining pipelines and responding to defined stakeholder metric requests (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role: Demonstrated experience designing and deploying production-grade agentic AI workflows.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to design and deploy production-grade agentic AI workflows as data infrastructure, the defining signal of ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement version control practices and monitor for pipeline or data issues.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality, monitoring, and governance are framed as owned responsibilities with explicit ownership verbs (ensure, monitor, implement), not just tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensure data quality and consistency... monitor for pipeline or data issues... promote best data governance practices
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data quality, consistency, and governance are named as ongoing secondary concerns without regulatory or stakeholder-trust framing dominating the JD, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and deploy next-generation BI and analytics tools that give Commercial teams direct, confident self-serve access to data.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-build language (design and deploy next-generation tools, design gold-layer assets) with maintain language (maintain robust data pipelines and models) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
